In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the synthesis of a high-quality 2D nitrogendoped mesoporous film carbon catalyst for ORR can be achieved by using graphene oxide as a carbon source, triblock copolymeric F127 as a template, and silica as a sacrificial hard template.
